classification.difficultyReason: Identify corresponding sides in differently oriented right triangles and rearrange their similarity proportion.

content.prompt: Find the formula, with $x$ as its subject, that can be used to calculate the value of $x$ if $a$, $b$, $c$ and $d$ are known.

spec.description: Large right triangle with an interior segment perpendicular to its hypotenuse. Dimensions b and c end at the specified base vertices; dimension d ends at the perpendicular foot on the hypotenuse. Ordinary source blue strokes are rendered black under house style.
spec.mathematics: The small triangle and the large triangle share their left angle and each have a right angle. Their corresponding sides are d with b and x with a. The base remainder c remains supplied.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the source givens a, b, c and d and the unknown x are visible.

answer.short:
$x=\dfrac{ad}{b}$.

Use corresponding sides of the similar right triangles.
answer.worked:
The small triangle and the large triangle have a common angle at the left vertex and a pair of right angles, so they are similar (AAA). The sides $x$ and $a$ correspond, as do $d$ and $b$.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{x}{a}&=\frac{d}{b}\\x&=\frac{ad}{b}\end{align*}$$
